params.name: fundraisingTeams

params.name: fundraisingPages
params.description: Flag to fetch source codes associated to Fundraising Pages under the Campaign.

params.name: transactions
params.description: Flag to fetch source codes associated to Transactions under the Campaign.

params.name: page
params.description: Indicator of which page of results to return

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of entries to return in each page of results
